posts.title: You Can't Force a Flame from a Well
posts.description: What do I need to see today? I pulled from the Ethereal Visions deck by Matt Hughes and actually got one of the specialty cards in the deck "The Well". XXII. posts.title: Right Now, According to the Hanged Man
posts.description: I don’t love doing tarot for shadow-work and self reflection, but I do find a lot of comfort in the cards.
